ios.desc:
Control Your Mac from Your iPhone - Fast, Private, Local

Argly transforms your iPhone into a powerful remote control for your Mac. 


Full Desktop Control


Real-time screen mirroring with adaptive quality
Precise mouse and trackpad control
Full keyboard input with special keys (Return, Tab, Esc, Delete)
Quick shortcuts for Cmd+C, Cmd+V, and more
Pinch-to-zoom and pan gestures

Lock Screen Unlock
Unlock your Mac directly from your iPhone
Secure password entry
Works even when your Mac is locked

Smart Keyboard
Custom keyboard overlay optimized for remote control
Color-coded special keys for quick access
Haptic feedback for all actions
Quick shortcuts for common commands

Favorite Shortcuts
Save your most-used keyboard shortcuts
Floating shortcuts panel for quick access
Easy add/remove with intuitive edit mode

Perfect For:
Working from your couch or bed
Accessing your Mac when away from your desk
Presenting from your iPhone
